name: Sendspin Media Source
description: The `sendspin` media source platform plays synchronized audio from a [Sendspin](https://esphome.io/components/sendspin/) group through a [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source/). The Sendspin [hub](https://esphome.io/components/sendspin/) must be configured on the same device.
